title: Universal Still Plans Overseas Release for Alex Gibney’s ‘Musk’ Documentary Despite Mogul’s Legal Threats
content:
ByPat Saperstein

Deputy Editor

Contrary to a recent report, Universal is moving forward as planned with the international release ofAlex Gibney‘sElon Muskdocumentary “Musk,” sources familiar with the project toldVariety.

Though a release date has not yet been set for the overseas rollout, that’s not unusual for a film like “Musk,” a nearly 4-hour long documentary that’s being released theatrically in North American on Oct. 9 by the indie distrib Bleecker Street.

Despite recent legal threats from Musk over the documentary’s content, Universal has always been enthusiastic about releasing the film internationally, the sources added. “Musk” is set to stream on HBO in the first quarter of 2027.

After the documentary premiered at the Venice Film Festival, the tech mogul beganposting commentson X, calling the doc “a hit piece,” though it was not clear whether he had seen the film.

Musk asserted that Gibney had “just assembled a hit list of people who either have an axe to grind or don’t even know me (but still have an axe to grind).” Among the interviews featured in Gibney’s film is one with Ashley St. Clair, a MAGA influencer who had a child with Musk. The documentary portrays a text exchange between the two about the 2024 presidential election.

Musk’s attorney Alex Spirothreatened to filea defamation lawsuit before the film’s release in October, pointing to Musk’s texts with St. Clair.

Variety critic Owen Gleiberman wrote inhis reviewof “Musk” in Venice, “Once you start piecing together Musk’s scandals and cut corners and slipshod management, you see that he’s a creator of mirages who promises more than he delivers … Musk, as the documentary makes clear, is a genuine if flawed technocratic visionary, a messianic opportunist, and something of a crackpot,”Universal and Gibney had no comment.
title_zh: 環球影業(Universal)仍計劃在海外發行亞歷克斯·吉本尼(Alex Gibney)的《馬斯克(Musk)》紀錄片，儘管這位大亨面臨法律威脅。
content_zh:
作者：帕特·薩佩斯坦(Pat Saperstein)

副編輯

根據熟悉該項目的消息來源告訴《綜藝》(Variety)，與最近的報導相反，環球影業(Universal)正按計劃推進亞歷克斯·吉本尼(Alex Gibney)的伊隆·馬斯克(Elon Musk)紀錄片《馬斯克》(Musk)的國際發行。

儘管尚未為海外上映設定具體日期，但對於像《馬斯克》這樣的電影來說，這並不罕見，該紀錄片長達近4小時，將於10月9日在北美由獨立發行商Bleecker Street上映。

消息來源補充道，儘管馬斯克最近對紀錄片內容提出法律威脅，環球影業一直對國際發行該片充滿熱情。《馬斯克》計劃於2027年第一季度在HBO上串流播放。

在紀錄片於威尼斯電影節首映後，這位科技大亨開始在X平台上發表評論，稱該紀錄片為“攻擊片”，儘管尚不清楚他是否看過這部電影。

馬斯克聲稱吉本尼“只是匯編了一份攻擊名單，裡面的人要麼有私怨，要麼根本不認識我（但仍然有私怨）。”吉本尼的影片中包括了與阿什莉·聖克萊爾(Ashley St. Clair)的訪談，聖克萊爾是一位與馬斯克有孩子的MAGA影響者。該紀錄片描繪了兩人關於2024年總統選舉的短信交流。

馬斯克的律師亞歷克斯·斯皮羅(Alex Spiro)威脅在電影於10月上映前提起誹謗訴訟，並指出馬斯克與聖克萊爾的短信內容。

《綜藝》的評論家奧文·格萊伯曼(Owen Gleiberman)在他對《馬斯克》的評價中寫道：“一旦你開始拼湊馬斯克的醜聞和草率的管理，你會發現他是一位創造幻影的人，承諾的遠比實際交付的要多……紀錄片清楚地表明，馬斯克是一位真正但有缺陷的技術專家願景者，一位彌賽亞式的機會主義者，以及某種程度上的怪人。”環球影業和吉本尼對此未作評論。
